dispatch-list.name: Dispatch List
dispatch-list.description: Build a day or work-center dispatch list from the work-order export, the shop calendar, and the work-center list.

due-date-list.name: Due Date List
due-date-list.description: Sort open work orders by due date from their export and flag lines that fall on a closed calendar day or that already miss the printed due.

eco-pending-as-file.name: Pending ECO as File
eco-pending-as-file.description: List open work orders against the ECO log and the drawing index. Pending changes stay pending.

kit-list.name: Kit List
kit-list.description: Build a pick or kit list from the bill export times job qty, then mark short lines from the inventory export.

machine-down-vs-wip.name: Machine-Down versus WIP
machine-down-vs-wip.description: Put the machine-status file next to open work at those work centers. Down stays visible.

outside-process-due.name: Outside-Process Due List
outside-process-due.description: List send-out operations from the work-order export against the outside-PO list. Promise dates come only from that PO file.

shortage-vs-inventory.name: Shortage List versus Inventory
shortage-vs-inventory.description: Compare each open job’s bill times remaining job qty to the inventory export. Write every short row on the shortage sheet.

traveler-completeness.name: Traveler Completeness Pack
traveler-completeness.description: Check traveler PDFs against the work-order export and the drawing index. Flag missing operations, revision mismatches, missing outside rows, and unsigned boxes as completeness only.

wip-by-center.name: WIP by Work Center
wip-by-center.description: Group open work-order quantity by work center from the export and the work-center list. Do not hide WIP.
